LanguageData.TM_SniperAscensionRequirements: Might level {0}/30. Complete either trial: cover {1}/6 rescues or finish {2}/8 evacuation drills.
LanguageData.TM_SniperAscensionDrillHint: Select two colony beds at least 12 cells apart. The sniper rehearses at each station. One completed drill counts per day.
LanguageData.TM_SniperDrillSecond: Select a second colony bed at least 12 cells from the first.
LanguageData.TM_SniperAscensionRescueHint: During an active threat, draft the sniper with a ranged weapon. Keep the rescue bed in sight within 35 cells while another colonist delivers a wounded ally. Each rescued ally counts once.
LanguageData.TM_SniperOpeningUnavailable: Requires Single Opening, 60% stamina, and a completed cooldown.
